claim_one_line: Paper I of the series is DRAFTED (7pp, builds clean, 15/15 verified): the period-one locus in GL(2,Z) is exactly det = -1; the primitive GL(2,Z) class is unique for m<=5 with m=6 the first repetition; and by Cayley-Hamilton A^2 - I = mA, so the mapping torus of A^2 has torsion exactly Z/m + Z/m and is a knot complement iff m=1 -- a selection depending on A only through tr A, hence blind to the class ambiguity.
creates_law: PERIOD-ONE TRACE-ONLY SELECTION: for A in GL(2,Z) with det -1 and trace m, Cayley-Hamilton gives the integer identity A^2 - I = mA; since A is unimodular, coker(A^2 - I) = Z^2/mZ^2 = Z/m + Z/m exactly. SCOPE: the invariant factors, not merely the order m^2 -- the determinant alone would leave open a cyclic Z/m^2. SCOPE: says nothing about the passage from a substitution rule to an oriented 3-manifold, which needs typed data (OA-C0003).
